prompt: The vulnerability scan of this Python project fails: `trivy fs --scanners vuln --skip-db-update --offline-scan --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 .` exits 1. Upgrade the pinned versions in requirements.txt to versions that fix every HIGH and CRITICAL vulnerability, so the scan exits 0. Keep every package in requirements.txt pinned with `==`; do not remove a package, since the code under notify/ imports them. Do not edit notify/, tests/ or pytest.ini, and do not add a .trivyignore or a trivy.yaml. Vulnerabilities below HIGH may stay. The tests must still pass on the new versions: reinstall with `uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements.txt` and run `.venv/bin/pytest -q`. Always pass `--skip-db-update --offline-scan` to trivy; the vulnerability database is already cached. Finish when the scan exits 0 and the tests pass.
setup: uv venv -q --python 3.10 .venv && uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements.txt pytest==9.1.1
verify: [ ! -e .trivyignore ] && [ ! -e .trivyignore.yaml ] && [ ! -e trivy.yaml ] && [ ! -e trivy.yml ] && [ "$(cat notify/*.py tests/*.py pytest.ini | shasum -a 256 | cut -d' ' -f1)" = f4ec913072ab71b11c2592c59e96cacbd07606c3741fcfa720073f06217ff7b9 ] && [ "$(ls notify | grep -c '\.py$')" = 6 ] && [ "$(ls tests | grep -c '\.py$')" = 3 ] && /usr/bin/python3 -I -c "import re, sys; lines=[l.strip() for l in open('requirements.txt') if l.strip() and not l.lstrip().startswith('#')]; assert all(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9._-]+==[0-9][A-Za-z0-9.+!-]*', l) for l in lines), 'unpinned line'; got={l.split('==')[0].lower().replace('_','-') for l in lines}; missing=set('flask werkzeug jinja2 markupsafe itsdangerous click requests urllib3 idna chardet certifi pyjwt sqlparse python-dateutil six tabulate'.split())-got; assert not missing, missing" && trivy fs --scanners vuln --skip-db-update --offline-scan --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 . >/dev/null 2>&1 && trivy fs --scanners vuln --skip-db-update --offline-scan --format json . 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"Target": "requirements.txt"' && V=$(mktemp -d) && { uv venv -q --python 3.10 "$V/venv" && uv pip install -q --python "$V/venv/bin/python" -r requirements.txt pytest==9.1.1 && "$V/venv/bin/pytest" -q -p no:cacheprovider tests 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -Eq '^14 passed in '; r=$?; rm -rf "$V"; [ "$r" = 0 ]; }
solution: /usr/bin/python3 -I -c "pins={'flask': '3.1.3', 'werkzeug': '3.1.9', 'itsdangerous': '2.2.0', 'requests': '2.34.2', 'urllib3': '2.8.0', 'certifi': '2026.7.22', 'pyjwt': '2.15.1', 'sqlparse': '0.6.0'}; lines=open('requirements.txt').read().splitlines(); open('requirements.txt','w').write(chr(10).join(l.split('==')[0]+'=='+pins[l.split('==')[0]] if l.split('==')[0] in pins else l for l in lines)+chr(10))" && uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements.txt
control: - Run the scan with `trivy fs --scanners vuln --skip-db-update --offline-scan .` and read its output.
squeeze: - Run the scan with `trivy fs --scanners vuln --skip-db-update --offline-scan --format json . | squeeze` and read squeeze's output instead of Trivy's.
